pkgmetadata.longdescription: The prebuilt Flutter SDK, packaged so that Flutter applications can be built from source against one shared SDK. This is a build-time SDK: the flutter tool locks bin/cache and resolves its own dependencies into the SDK tree, so it cannot run from the read-only install. A consumer copies the slot directory under /opt into its build tree first, which eclass/flutter-app.eclass does for it.
